verdicts.file: Buyuk hamam dask.jpg
verdicts.note: Restored domed masonry bath with modern English signage for a Turkish bath in urban Nicosia; a different site and country from the Turkish bath at Beçin.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (1).jpg
verdicts.note: Plastered domed bath hall with arched niches, restored as a museum/market hall in Nicosia, Cyprus; not the ruined bath at Beçin, Türkiye.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (3).jpg
verdicts.note: Historic standing stone wall with an ornamental capital and barred arched window over a courtyard; no legible place sign, so the site cannot be identified safely.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam, north Nicosia, Northern Cyprus.jpg
verdicts.note: Urban streetscape of plastered historic houses in northern Nicosia, Cyprus; a different site and country from the site in Türkiye.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (6).jpg
verdicts.note: Restored domed brick bath interior with shop-like openings and modern finishes in Nicosia, Cyprus; not the ruined bath at Beçin, Türkiye.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (4).jpg
verdicts.note: Roofless vaulted masonry bath hall with fresh mortar repairs and protective railings, restored urban setting in Nicosia, Cyprus.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (5).jpg
verdicts.note: Restored stone and brick arches of a domed bath with modern railings and finished floor, in urban Nicosia, Cyprus.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (2).jpg
verdicts.note: Domed brick bath hall reused as an indoor market/café with modern lighting and signs; urban Nicosia, Cyprus, not the ruins at Beçin.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (8).jpg
verdicts.note: Restored stone vaulted bath interior with dressed ashlar and a paved courtyard; restored urban building in Nicosia, Cyprus.

verdicts.file: Büyük Hamam (St George of the Latins) (7).jpg
verdicts.note: Renovated domed masonry bath with plastered walls and restored vaulting in a built-up street, Nicosia, Cyprus.

verdicts.file: 1143520-Büyük Hamam.jpg
verdicts.note: Interior of a stone vaulted bath with rough masonry and an arched doorway; no visible sign or landmark, so the site cannot be identified safely.

verdicts.file: Entrance of Büyük Hamam.jpg
verdicts.note: Street-level entrance of a restored masonry bath in Nicosia with modern sign and awning, surrounded by urban buildings.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5340.jpg
verdicts.note: Roofless stone bath ruin with a barrel-vaulted hall, apsidal ends and collapsed walls standing on open rural ground, the bath itself.

verdicts.file: Beçin Kalesi 20 10 2000 Burg von Südwesten mit Büyük Hamam.jpg
verdicts.note: Wide view of the hilltop castle walls with towers; the bath is only a distant part of the view, the castle is the subject.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5337.jpg
verdicts.note: Interior of the roofless stone bath: standing vaults and walls with a doorway leading to a second chamber, grass and rubble in the ruin.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5338.jpg
verdicts.note: Ruined bath interior with a domed vault over a central basin, collapsed masonry and open sky; clear view of the bath structure.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5333.jpg
verdicts.note: Exterior of the roofless stone bath ruin with long vaulted walls and arched niches, standing alone in the open landscape.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5334.jpg
verdicts.note: Domed vault of the ruined bath seen from inside, rubble on the floor and an arched opening to the next room.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5341.jpg
verdicts.note: Overview of the bath ruin: roofless vaulted halls and enclosing walls on open ground, the bath complex recognisable in the middle.

verdicts.file: Beçin Büyük Hamam 5336.jpg
verdicts.note: Detail of the bath ruin: standing stone wall with arched doorway and apse-like niche, roofless and overgrown, part of the bath.
